newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-RANGERS NOTCH 50TH LEAGUE GOAL OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RANGERS NOTCH 50TH LEAGUE GOAL OF SEASON.

text.p: Glasgow Rangers notched their 50th Scottish premier division goal of the season as they trounced bottom club Raith 4-0 at Ibrox on Thursday.

First-half goals from skipper Richard Gough and England midfielder Paul Gascoigne set Rangers on course for their fourth victory in less than two weeks as they chase their ninth successive league title.
Jorg Albertz added a third before Ally McCoist scored Rangers' 50th league goal of the campaign with a 20-metre strike only 10 minutes from time.
Leaders Rangers are now 17 points clear of arch rivals Celtic, who have four games in hand.
An 80th minute goal from Steve Fulton gave Hearts a 3-2 win at Dunfermline after a compelling second half.
Derek Fleming gave Dunfermline a 25th minute lead but Hearts equalised in the 57th minute when Colin Miller deflected a Gary Mackay cross past his own goalkeeper.

In the 68th minute Dunfermline took the lead again through Allan Moore but Hearts were back on terms when John Robertson netted from the penalty spot and then secured the points through Fulton's late strike.
Jim McIntyre underlined relegation-threatened Kilmarnock's recent improvement by securing a crucial 1-0 victory at Hibernian.
The striker notched a splendid 42nd minute goal to give his team, next to bottom before the match, their third win this season over the Edinburgh side, who were weakened by injury and illness.
